$meta.name: VowOS
$meta.note: This file is the only place a token value may be edited. prototype/styles/tokens.css is generated from it by design-system/build.mjs and must never be hand-edited. Extends Project VowOS UI and Experience Plan v1.1, sections 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 11.1; governed by VowOS Design Program Masterplan sections 4 and 9.

porcelain.usage: Primary page background. Never pure high-glare white by default.

paper.usage: Readbacks, notes, decision surfaces, secondary panes. Always carries a hairline border so layering never depends on fill alone.

inkInverse.usage: Text and icons placed on terracotta, moss, alert, or ink fills.

ash.usage: Metadata and supporting explanation only. Never a critical action.

moss.usage: Confirmed, trusted, or ready states. The only accent cleared for small text.

terracotta.usage: Primary button fill and agent-note rules. FILL ONLY — see contrast finding CF-01, not cleared for body text.

terracottaDeep.usage: Hover and active state of the primary button. Derived, not an independent brand color.

roseClay.usage: Decorative fills and palette previews. Never the only status signal, never a text color.

mistBlue.usage: Calendar, travel, neutral planning context. Never a text color.

softGold.usage: Rare emphasis or a meaningful selected detail. Never a text color.

alert.usage: Errors and genuine deadline risk only. Not ordinary attention.

hairline.usage: Card and surface borders, table rules.

hairlineStrong.usage: Secondary button borders, input borders, focus-adjacent edges.

overlay.usage: Behind bottom sheets and approval dialogs.

focus.usage: Visible keyboard focus. Persistent while focus remains, per WCAG 2.2 Focus Visible.

washSubtle.usage: Hover on an inline editable region

washSelected.usage: Current navigation item, pressed toggle, chip fill, meter track

state.$note: Derived from ink rather than restated as literals, so ink's value still lives in exactly one place. If color-mix is unavailable the wash drops out and the state is still carried by weight, border, and wording, which is UI Plan section 13 working as intended.

display.value: "Newsreader", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Palatino, Georgia, serif
display.usage: Welcome moments, page titles, large place stories. Never in dense operational views.

ui.value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui.usage: All functional text, labels, controls, and body copy.

display.usage: Page display heading. 34px floor is the mobile scale from UI Plan 3.2.

body.usage: Default body. Floor of the 16-18px band in UI Plan 3.2.

bodySmall.usage: Dense supporting copy and control labels

label.usage: Eyebrow labels. Sentence case, never all caps by default.

ease.usage: Ease-out for all transitions. Content moves a short distance.

contentWidth.usage: Primary reading column, inside the 760-900px band in UI Plan 11.1
